params.label: G and K
params.desc: G and K scaled together (Poisson ratio kept)

params.label: α
params.desc: constant term of the TXC meridian (strength level)

params.label: θ
params.desc: linear term of the TXC meridian (pressure sensitivity)

params.label: λ
params.desc: nonlinear term of the TXC meridian

params.label: N<sub>H</sub>, C<sub>H</sub>
params.desc: initial yield fraction and hardening rate

params.label: G<sub>ft</sub> and G<sub>fs</sub>
params.desc: tensile and shear fracture energy together

params.label: repow
params.desc: power on fracture energy for rate effects

params.label: ERODE
params.desc: erosion (damage > 0.99 and max principal strain > ERODE-1)

params.label: friction, free ends
params.desc: end faces free to slide, Coulomb friction μ
